effect.name: Marching Ants Outline (Texture) [Type 4]
effect.description: This shader adds a border to the object using the pixelated checkboard "marching ants" pattern.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Marching Ants Outline (Texture) [Type 4] Shader | 2026.09.01 */
parameter.description: This shader adds a border to the object using the pixelated checkboard "marching ants" pattern.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Size
parameter.description: This variable defines the scale of the pattern.

parameter.name: Offset
parameter.description: This variable specifies the outline size.

parameter.name: Color Light
parameter.description: This variable specifies the selected color for the monochrome output.

parameter.name: Color Shadow
parameter.description: This variable specifies the selected color for the monochrome output. Decides what color should appear for darker colors.
